note: Hebrew 'alluph means a clan chief or tribal head; "duke" (from Latin dux, leader) now suggests European nobility. The same applies throughout vv. 15-43.

kjv: found the mules in the wilderness
mine: found the hot springs in the wilderness
note: The hapax hayyemim is best understood (with the Vulgate aquas calidas) as hot springs; "mules" follows a Jewish tradition, and mule-breeding was forbidden to Israel anyway.
